q: The entropy of a sofic shift X (image of an SFT Y under factor map π) satisfies:
opts: h_top(X) ≤ h_top(Y) with equality in many cases
exp: Since X = π(Y) is a factor (image under continuous surjective factor map), h_top(X) ≤ h_top(Y). Equality holds for finite-to-one factor maps (bounded-to-one). The entropy of a sofic shift equals log ρ(A) for the adjacency matrix of its minimal right-resolving presentation.
